Generated files -- do not hand-edit.

`JetBrainsMonoNFM-{Regular,Bold}.woff2` are JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono, subset
to the codepoints used by the committed `.cast` recordings, and loaded by the
`@font-face` rules in `../custom.css` so the embedded asciinema player can draw
Nerd Font glyphs on machines that don't have the font installed.

Regenerate with `docs/regenerate-docs-font.sh` (pins the Nerd Fonts release
version) after adding or re-recording a cast. See "Regenerate the font" in
`docs/screencasts/README.md`.

`LICENSE.txt` is the SIL Open Font License 1.1 shipped with the upstream font.
